result.summary: Introduces a new "mining" debug logging category (-debug=mining) and changes the CreateNewBlock() summary log from unconditional LogInfo to LogDebug under this new category.
result.problem: CreateNewBlock() outputs a log line with block weight, transaction count, fee, and sigop metrics on every block template construction. For operators running software like Electrum servers that frequently request block templates, this floods debug.log without any option to suppress it.
evidence: Fixes #36334: "log: frequent `CreateNewBlock()` log lines on 32.x with electrum server"
result.card: Introduces a new mining logging category (-debug=mining) and moves the CreateNewBlock() log line behind it. Previously, block assembly metrics were unconditionally logged as LogInfo on every template creation, flooding debug.log for operators running services like Electrum servers that poll block templates frequently. Issue #36334 reports log bloat with no existing mechanism to disable the output.

risk.why: Only changes the logging level and category of a single debug line in block assembly.
